steps.name: A Voice on the News
steps.text: The Blood Knight has successfully made his way to the finals, becoming only the second knight in the history of the Kazimierz Major to have a chance of defending his title.

steps.name: A Voice on the News
steps.text: However, the Blood Knight's status as an Infected continues to draw criticism. A General Chamber of Commerce spokesman came out with this statement: 'The Blood Knight will not be treated differently on the basis of his status as an Infected'––

steps.name: A Voice on the News
steps.text: Nevertheless, some knight families do not agree with this statement, and in light of the recent power outage and recurrence of the Great Separation, an incredible amount of public pressure has been mounting. Next, we invite a representative of the Knights Association to speak on the matter––

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...Dikaiopolis! The Blood Knight!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Haha! Now that's what I'm talking about! That's how an Infected knight should be!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: If the Radiant Knight defeats the Wind Knight, then...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It'll be Infected against Infected.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: The champion of the Major will be decided between the Infected.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Haha! Isn't that a good thing?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: We'll show those bigwigs that their shining city isn't so invincible after all. Then, the Blood Knight and the Radiant Knight will tear off their veil of secrecy and reveal their crimes––

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The Infected will finally taste victory!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: If only things could be so simple.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: As for us, what do we do next?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ahaha... Well, it's not like we have any future in the Grand Knight Territory anyway.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But we can get our hands on some legal papers and find some place, maybe a nice village, to quietly live our lives.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: That's not what we set out to do.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: We're not ready to stash away our armor and pick up the plow just yet, Sona!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Are we not fighting to make sure those suffering from Oripathy can be treated fairly?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The purpose of us informing the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi about what the K.G.C.C. has been doing in Area 0... Was that not to save more Infected?!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Our job here isn't done yet!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I can't really argue with that, Sona.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: If we leave now, it'd be like giving up halfway.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Sona?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Why will most of the Infected be left behind?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No, that isn't the right question. Let me think... Why do the Infected... never seem to matter?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Workers exposed to high-risk environments, farmers with no way to avoid Catastrophes, the homeless who wander between cities with nowhere to go... These are the people most afflicted by Oripathy.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...A refined gemstone.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: That might be the first Originium the knight-nobles ever saw.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Of course Oripathy doesn't concern them.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Why do you pose that question?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No reason in particular.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Will Szewczyk go with us?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: What nonsense are you going on about now?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Oh, you were here all along.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: How's the wife and kid?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Well. That's why I came by to give my regards. As long as they're safe, anything else goes.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: However, I am no Infected. On the face of it, I can even retain my legal status as a knight.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: I don't plan to stay in the Grand Knight Territory. I'll use the prize money I earned over the years to buy some property and start a new life in a different city.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Have you considered living somewhere other than a nomadic city? It'll probably be better for avoiding unwanted eyes and ears.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: That isn't 'living,' that's called 'surviving'

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Anyway, I'm here to say goodbye. The Major isn't over yet, and there are many people moving in and out. It's a good opportunity to quietly slip out of the Grand Knight Territory.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: A new city, huh...

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, there's something I have to tell you all.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: The fact that the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi has been informed of the Armorless Union and of the Infected containment and treatment facility does not necessarily mean that they'll immediately move to depose the K.G.C.C.––

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: ––No, I'd go far as to say that right now, they don't even have the ability to threaten the General Chamber of Commerce.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: You likely picked up on this as well, right?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Call me cold if you want, but this has nothing to do with me anymore.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: For the sake of the short time we fought side-by-side... Take care of yourselves. Don't challenge the city, Flametail.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What, did you just show up to rain on our parade?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: This is why I can't stand knight-nobles.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Challenge... the city, huh.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: It sounds just like one of those silly knight novels...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Doctor.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I've been your bodyguard for a while. So... what do you think of me?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I'll be honest. Just being in the same as room as you... makes my heart beat a little faster, you know?

options: Now's not the time for personal questions.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Aww... That's too bad.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: But I think... You're acting dense on purpose?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Your silence definitely gives you that sort of mysterious allure, but... If you're always so absorbed in your work, Doctor, you'll end up burning out.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: This is a business inquiry regarding the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi's partnership with Rhodes Island... Your opinion of me is very important.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor! Nearl reached the grand finals!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: 'The Wind Knight Forfeits, the Radiant Knight Advances with a Bye!' It was a headline in today's paper!

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: The Wind Knight is only one step away from retirement, and most likely doesn't want to go out with a loss to the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Really makes me jealous of that Radiant Knight, seeing how much you care about her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: G-Gravel?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Oh, I didn't mean anything by that.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: ...At least for now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, uh... Haha...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (D-Doctor, don't you think Gravel has been in a bad mood recently? She seems to be getting more and more... Huh? You think it's her personality?)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Um, all right. If that's what you believe...)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Wait... Hold on...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: How many men do I have?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Three squads.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What about you and Monique?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: We have other work to do.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Then...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Don't even think about Darksteel.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: They also have their jobs to do.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Is the Union...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: If you've figured it out, you'd do best to behave yourself and act like you don't know anything. You do want to live, don't you?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: So, with these three squads, I'm responsible for guarding the Major arena and serving as the early warning, right?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...for the battle of the Blood Knight and the Radiant Knight?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...and with the possibility of coming face-to-face with a Silverlance Pegasus?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...Alright. Are you asking me to commit suicide...?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I wouldn't put it that way. Just don't do anything, and you'll be fine.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: How much longer are you going to use me?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: ––I'm glad you're so self-aware.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What's going to happen to me after the Major is over?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Depends on your performance. If you're just asking me though, at least...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I'd prefer to let you live.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Uncle...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You've already brought things to this step, doing whatever you feel like, with no concern for others' opinions.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Have you ever thought of all the people you're harming through your juvenile actions?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Have you ever considered that Marcin and the others will now be at the mercy of the Armorless Union?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Have you ever considered that Maria and Zofia may no longer be able to live safely in the Grand Knight Territory?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You may hold your own ideals in a vacuum, Margaret, but remember this: Your greatest mistake is trying to determine the trajectories of other peoples' lives.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: There is not a soul who has that right.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I am extremely disappointed in you.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maria, tell me the truth.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Did I rob you of your dreams?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You handed both the family name and the right to enter the tournament to me... You...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret! That's never crossed my mind!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I just... don't think I'm cut out to be a knight.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...I'm listening, Maria.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It's been so long since I've heard you... confide in someone else.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I... don't understand what you're doing...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I've been doubting... what the point of a knight even is anymore.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: When we stand victorious in the arena, what is it the audience cheers for? What have we won?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Even if... you wanted to beat them at their own game, to defeat those rogues who want to keep you from winning...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: What if they let you win because they get something out of it?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Or, what if they were never beholden to the rules of the game in the first place?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: From the beginning, they never had an ounce of concern about the knights. This, I already knew.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: There is no meaning to me becoming the champion.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But to those watching us... it means the world.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maria, if you think this city – this country – is sick, what do you think is the root cause of the illness?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The corruption of the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi? The General Chamber of Commerce's endless expansion and exploitation?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It might be either, or even both.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: We often say that Kazimierz needs to regain its former glory, and every so often, someone needs to remind it what glory and justice are.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But it is not just the knights who need to recover that glory.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Victory is not about defeating some enemy. 'To be a knight is to be the noble light that illuminates the land..'

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But after illuminating the path forward, clearing the thorns, and filling up the pitfalls...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: A knight should have taught all those who seek freedom to overcome hardship.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Finally awake, huh? Took you long enough. Thought you were dead.

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: You... You're a Sarkaz...?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: And you can talk. Looks like you're doing better than your brother.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Don't worry, he's not dead either.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: This special salve is usually used for armor repair. So this is what happens when you apply it directly to humans...

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: The principle behind it is activation? What exactly do Kazimierz suits of armor have in common with humans? Both humans and armor can be activated? Then, what about Originium slugs?

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: You... You're a de-horned Sarkaz...

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: Are you... with the Armorless Union?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Hah, I'll take that as a compliment. Those guys make three thousand times more than I do.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I'm a bounty hunter. I'm here in the Grand Knight Territory on a bit of business, as well as... a little investigation related to the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Of course, it's nothing official. Just a personal curiosity of mine.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: ––Have you seen any other Sarkaz with trimmed horns?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Who cut off yours?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Who would use... the Sarkaz... as slaves and test subjects?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: All right. I suppose you've been whipped pretty thoroughly.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Want to come with me?

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Big guys like you should be able to help out with some handy work, right? We're camped in the wastelands, and we're lacking hands more than anything else–

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: ––Come with me, Sarkaz.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Come with me, and you just might survive.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Batbayar...?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You poor lad. Your folks won't even pay the bills for you when you're in the hospital.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: But your body is undoubtedly sturdy. Anyone else in your position wouldn't have much life left in them after a bout with the Blood Knight.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Even if you're an independent knight, you should've at least had some money saved up from making it to the semifinals. Where'd it all go?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Stop moving around. Your wounds are deep.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hey, hold on! Where are you going?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: ...I'm leaving.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: A golden pegasus, a crimson Minoan. I... I've gained much.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You're unhappy?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: ...No, I failed.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I won't fear failure anymore.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I won't be afraid to retreat anymore.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I won't fear... the beauty of weakness.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: ...But I am still lacking... I have yet to finish my Khaganquest.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Khaganquest this, Khaganquest that... Do you even know where you're going?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Even in ancient times, it's not like there was a path you were supposed to follow for years, right?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: North.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: In the distant north... the echoing north where my ancestors disappeared.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: And after you make your way there, then what?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Are you going to come back?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You... I assumed you were searching for something you were missing.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: But it turns out... are you searching for a place to die?
